loop: log --- catch a clear day in a Sky Jar
assert caught a sky | execute if items entity @a container.* tempestas:caught_sky
log --- the Weather Condenser draws ember salt from desert air
assert condenser placed | execute if block 60 -60 60 tempestas:weather_condenser
await ember salt condensed | 1800 | execute if data block 60 -60 60 Items[{id:"tempestas:ember_salt"}]
expectinv took the salt out | tempestas:ember_salt | 1
notes: Sky Jar catches the clear day sky (time 6000, weather clear, open sky on superflat). Condenser in a desert patch (fillbiome) makes ember salt in 1200 ticks. Every recipe is checked headless; blocks are placed and kept by the kit.
